summary: Deployment-dependency fix verified. Fresh venv `pip install -r /app/backend/requirements.txt` succeeded (exit 0) with no emergentintegrations/litellm references. All required modules import cleanly (fastapi, uvicorn, motor, pydantic, email_validator, asyncssh, cryptography.fernet, bcrypt, jwt, dotenv, websockets, multipart) and `import server` works inside that isolated venv with env vars from /app/backend/.env. Static review of Docker inputs OK: backend Dockerfile copies requirements.txt then app; frontend Dockerfile uses `COPY package.json yarn.lock* ./` (wildcard) and `yarn install` without --frozen-lockfile; /app/frontend/Caddyfile present; /app/deploy/docker-compose.yml references ../backend and ../frontend build contexts; /app/deploy/env.example present with all needed vars. Regression against running backend: login admin@sshcentral.io/admin123 -> 200 (token len 243); GET /api/devices, /api/agents, /api/stats -> 200; POST /api/agents/044677e4.../test -> ok=true with 2-hop chain gw-minha-maquina -> jump-vpn returning agent-env output. Full pytest suite (/app/backend/tests) 20/20 PASSED in 12s including TestWebSocketTerminal::test_ws_terminal_chain which validates the WS 'Conectado' message. /tmp/reqtest cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: requirements.txt is now clean and minimal — good. Consider pinning to compatible ranges (>=x,<y) instead of exact pins for easier security patching, but exact pins are fine for reproducible Docker builds.

deploy/docker-compose.yml uses `network_mode: host` for both backend and frontend on the same VPS — intentional per README (needed so backend can reach 127.0.0.1:<tunnel_port> for reverse tunnels via VPS sshd). Documented. OK.

frontend Dockerfile does `yarn install` without --frozen-lockfile when yarn.lock is present — this can produce non-reproducible builds. Acceptable trade-off since yarn.lock may be absent, but consider `yarn install --frozen-lockfile` when yarn.lock exists (bind conditional) for reproducibility.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend deployment deps fix is fully verified. Local sshd runs on 127.0.0.1:2222 for chain tests; do not delete seeded agents/devices or the global SSH key. If sshd is down: `mkdir -p /run/sshd && /usr/sbin/sshd -f /app/sshd_test/sshd_config`.
